text: I can write a capped exponential backoff schedule with full jitter and explain why jitter prevents synchronised retry spikes.
I can tell a retryable error from a permanent one and explain why retrying at every layer multiplies load.
I can explain how a poison message wastes capacity in a plain queue and blocks an ordered partition.
I can configure a dead-letter queue (SQS redrive policy or RabbitMQ dead-letter exchange), alarm on it, and plan a safe redrive.
I can calculate backlog growth when producers outpace consumers and name three ways to apply backpressure.
I can pick a starting prefetch value from a consumer's concurrency and round-trip time, and say what symptoms mean it is too high or too low.
